name: Image Lightbox
description: Lets visitors click an image to see it large, with the caption underneath and arrows to browse every image on the page. Works with the keyboard and on phones.

panels.title: Image lightbox
panels.description: How images open when a visitor clicks them. Changes apply to a page the next time it is published.

fields.name: enabled
fields.title: Open images in a lightbox
fields.description: Turn this off to leave every page exactly as it was rendered.

fields.name: which
fields.title: Which images
fields.description: Images inside a link, the header, the menu or the footer never open, so logos and buttons keep working.

choices.title: Only images shown smaller than they are
Every image in the page content

fields.name: captions
fields.title: Show the image description as a caption
fields.description: Uses the description (alt text) you gave the image.

fields.name: arrows
fields.title: Show arrows to browse the other images
fields.description: Visitors can also use the arrow keys or swipe on a phone.

fields.name: skip-pages
fields.title: Skip these pages
fields.description: Page addresses separated by commas, for example: home, shop/*. A * at the end means every page under it.
